## d17f2bbc0878

**Reproduced rule-source divergence — erase-other-colors shortcut.** The Racket authority selects the globally least frequent nonzero color and crops the **original grid** to that color's bounding box. Thus another color inside that bounding box must survive. The generator instead places the two color regions with non-overlapping bounding boxes, and `self_check` rejects any overlap. A rival that erases every non-minority color before cropping is therefore indistinguishable on its sampled domain.

I sampled 100 actual draws in each difficulty band (300 total). All 300 passed the validator; the erase-other-colors rival matched the independent intended crop on all 300; none of the 300 outputs contained a majority-color cell inside the crop.

The retained `10×10` authority-domain witness has four color-2 minority cells defining a `5×5` bbox and eight color-1 majority cells, including one inside that bbox. Real Racket preserves that interior color-1 cell; the erase-other-colors rival deletes it, producing **one differing cell**. The target validator rejects the witness for overlapping bboxes. It also rejects **4/4 canonical inputs** for the same bbox-overlap restriction, even though the canonical Racket rule owns them. Full evidence is in `checks/audit-d17f2bbc0878-counterexample.json`.

This target was not modified. A repair should remove the unsupported bbox-separation invariant, accept canonical inputs, and schedule cases with non-minority cells inside the minority bbox so the crop-versus-extract distinction is teachable.

triage.reason: Both assigned findings independently reproduced against unchanged bound source hashes. 1165179c0d2e: 300/300 fixed marker/tied-size exclusion draws; actual canonical Racket counterexample differs in 17 cells and passes weak validator. Next repair: varying marker row/column, size ties and strict validation plus named rival witnesses. d17f2bbc0878: 300/300 erase-other-colors shortcut-compatible draws; actual Racket preserves an interior majority cell (one-cell disagreement); validator rejects witness and 4/4 canonical inputs. Next repair: remove unsupported bbox separation and schedule interior non-minority cells. Audit targets left unchanged; replay receipts in batch25a.

## d17f2bbc0878

**Reproduced canonical-domain exclusion and possible shortcut — the validator
requires disjoint color bounding boxes even though the canonical task does
not.** Generator SHA-256
`03e3c5fe633124313c92f8a53f3d7ec1388b79339ef99fd273863afc247c0522`;
executed rule hash `bab18680611f`.

Canonical training pair 0 has 90 cells of color 2 and 37 cells of color 3. The
color-2 bbox is `(0,0)..(17,18)` and the color-3 bbox is
`(11,10)..(17,18)`, so the bboxes overlap even though no cell has two colors.
The target `self_check` rejects this canonical input with
`"the two color regions' bboxes overlap — regions must be separated"`.
The authoritative Racket rule lawfully returns the 7×9 crop around color 3.
The full canonical input, Racket output, validator error, a differing shortcut
output, source hashes, command and cwd are in
`checks/audit/d17f2bbc0878/counterexample.json`; the public receipt is
`checks/audit/d17f2bbc0878/racket.json`.

The restriction is systematic in the sampled generator domain. With seed
`20261005` and sample indices `0..99` in each band, **300/300 generated grids**
had disjoint color bboxes and passed `self_check`. Consequently the plausible
shortcut "crop the minority only when the two color bboxes are disjoint;
otherwise do nothing" matched the intended minority-crop mirror on **300/300**
generated inputs but fails on the retained canonical input. This does not prove
a model will learn that shortcut, but it is a reproducible missing witness and
a validator rule unsupported by the Racket authority. The audit target was left
unchanged.

triage.reason: 15dd333aa99b: current-source production invariant violations (60/300 grids, blocked interiors and overwritten endpoints), validator accepted; already unapproved, concrete collision-aware repair lead. d17f2bbc0878: current-source canonical input exclusion plus a bbox-separation shortcut matching300/300 generated inputs but failing canonical input; already unapproved, concrete domain/teaching repair lead. Reviewer-reported Racket/source-bound evidence retained; no audit-only patch, generator execution or private replay performed.
